what: When a small link like ”Learn more” comes into view, its text fades in over .4s ease-in-out. .4s later a pale underline (only the right 19px dark) draws from the left over .4s, and the arrow, flipped −180° on the X axis, stands upright right away. On hover, a dark underline is redrawn from the right over .3s.

options.delay: Seconds from becoming visible until it turns on, default 0 — original data-delay .6
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: Arrow to be flipped (child, underline only if none)
options.--fx-line · --fx-line-strong · --fx-tip: Light underline · dark end · dark end length (style), defaults --kf-line · --kf-ink-soft · 19.2px

from.where: shared.css .tn-link (original .intersect-elem[data-effect=arrow_link] .cmn-link — opacity .4s ease-in-out · :before scaleX 0→1 .4s with .4s delay · .arrow rotateX(−180°)→0 .4s with .4s delay · :hover:after scaleX from the right .3s ease, IntersectionObserver bottom −15%)
